gaps.title: The dissolution buffer volume is missing
gaps.description: MP-DISSOLUTION-VOLUME is declared on N04 (Inclusion-body dissolution): sec. 2.6 specifies buffer composition but no volume, and sec. 4.4 reports 5460 AU without a concentration. The dissolved protein concentration is therefore not computable. The blocked targets are dissolved_protein_concentration.
gaps.why_it_matters: The dissolved protein concentration cannot be computed. The paper reports 5460 AU after dissolving a 17.9 g inclusion-body aliquot, but without a volume the AU reading cannot become a concentration.

existing_evidence.statement: sec. 2.6 specifies buffer composition but no volume, and sec. 4.4 reports 5460 AU without a concentration. The dissolved protein concentration is therefore not computable.

missing_evidence: The buffer volume used to dissolve the 17.9 g inclusion-body aliquot, or the final solution volume.
A measured protein concentration or an A280 value with a stated path length for the dissolved inclusion-body solution.
The mass of buffer salts and the pH adjustment volume, if they change the final volume.

what_information_is_needed: The missing volume, or a concentration measurement that makes the reported AU interpretable.
recommendation.why_it_is_needed: MP-DISSOLUTION-VOLUME blocks dissolved_protein_concentration. Supplying a volume from a different protocol would change the concentration the paper implies.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same inclusion-body isolation and dissolution protocol.
The buffer composition, its volume and the final solution volume.
A concentration, A280 with path length, or mass balance that closes the reported AU.
recommendation.what_scaleup_can_do: Record the volume as a protocol parameter, recompute the concentration transparently, and leave the original AU value untouched.

gaps.title: No target-context biological characterisation in the assessed library
gaps.description: Every assessed candidate differs from the target on organism, strain or construct. The compatibility records state, per candidate, that the organism is a different E. coli lineage or that the construct is absent or different. The baseline paper is the only record of E. coli 20 IBA 1 carrying pIBAINS, and it is not an independent source for its own gaps.
gaps.why_it_matters: A parameter or relationship measured in a different strain or construct cannot be entered as target-context evidence. The compatibility engine refuses such a candidate before any number is compared, so without a matched biological source no candidate can reach evidence_compatible or be composed.

existing_evidence.statement: The target process is recorded as: E. coli 20 IBA 1 (CSH50R derivative), plasmid pIBAINS, GMS medium, 4 L in a 7.5 L Bioflo Celligen 310, batch with pH-stat glucose feeding, 30 degC

Different substrate: glycerol plus a lumped complex substrate, fitted with one yield. Zielinski's carbon source is glucose in GMS medium. Different biomass basis: Ganjave's biomass is dry-cell weight; Zielinski reports wet biomass. No source here prints the factor between them. Different scale and mode: a 3 L vessel over 24 h of feeding, against a 4 L / 7.5 L reactor with pH-stat feeding. No port pair is permitted: every Zielinski <-> Ganjave pairing is mechanically legal and scientifically unsupported, so the policy fails closed.

Zielinski publishes process roles, not conserved chemical entities: no stream of its own carries a component amount or a mass fraction. A Morris port must name a component, and the names cannot agree; a control-volume total would require every entering unit to be attributable to one, and it is not. The engine already refuses this boundary (component identity), so the position is enforced rather than merely declared.

Different strain (W3110) and a different construct. Different induction mechanism: the paper's product is driven by a dissolved-oxygen step to 300% air saturation; Zielinski induces with IPTG. Different operating policy: an exponential feed in a 5 L reactor at 37 degC, against pH-stat feeding in a 4 L / 7.5 L reactor at 30 degC. No interface: the package is deliberately unregistered, publishes no ports and declares no supplyable quantity.

Different strain: K12 W3110 / RB791, with plasmids present but uninduced. Zielinski's culture is 20 IBA 1 carrying pIBAINS and producing insulin. Different medium, reactor and temperature: mineral salt medium, 15 L / 6 L Biostat ED, 35 degC, against GMS, a 7.5 L Celligen 310 and 30 degC. Its ports carry the state of its own culture (mu, qO, DOT, X, S). Handing those to Zielinski would transfer one experiment's state into another's. No interface: standalone and unregistered, with five constants the paper never values.

Different strain: non-recombinant MG1655, not 20 IBA 1 / pIBAINS. Different mode: steady-state continuous culture, not a fed-batch trajectory with pH-stat feeding. Different scale and temperature: a 10 mL mini-scale chemostat at 37 degC. Its maintenance coefficient and maximal yield are fitted for that chemostat and that medium. Transferring them would silently re-parameterise the insulin process. No interface: standalone and unregistered.

No shared quantity: Zielinski reports no biomass composition, and the dataset has no input port to receive one of its outputs. Different condition: MG1655 in M9 with 2% glucose at 37 degC, and the paper states that biomass composition is condition-dependent. It is a static table. A dataset cannot be executed as a dynamic component.

missing_evidence: An independent characterisation of E. coli 20 IBA 1 carrying pIBAINS in GMS medium, not merely a restatement of the baseline paper.
Plasmid burden, stability and induction response for pIBAINS in this host.
A physiological parameter set measured for this strain and construct under the target process conditions, if a candidate model states which quantity it needs.

what_information_is_needed: A biological characterisation made on the same host and construct as the target, independent of Zielinski et al. (2019).
recommendation.why_it_is_needed: The compatibility engine's identity dimensions require the same organism, strain, construct, medium and mode. No assessed candidate satisfies them, so the target's own biology remains a single-paper record.
suitable_paper_must_report: E. coli 20 IBA 1 or an explicitly identified CSH50R derivative.
The plasmid pIBAINS and its induction/expression behaviour.
GMS medium and the fed-batch operating policy, or a clear statement of which dimensions differ.
recommendation.what_scaleup_can_do: Run the existing identity comparison against the new source and record which dimensions match. Only a full match could support a compatibility reclassification; relevance alone cannot.

what_information_is_needed: The missing volume, or a concentration measurement that makes the reported AU interpretable.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-DISSOLUTION-VOLUME blocks dissolved_protein_concentration. Supplying a volume from a different protocol would change the concentration the paper implies.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same inclusion-body isolation and dissolution protocol.
The buffer composition, its volume and the final solution volume.
A concentration, A280 with path length, or mass balance that closes the reported AU.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Record the volume as a protocol parameter, recompute the concentration transparently, and leave the original AU value untouched.

what_information_is_needed: Target-context growth and glucose-uptake parameters, or the raw time series needed to estimate them.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: The model declares MP-GROWTH-KINETICS as the reason it cannot compute OD600, wet biomass or glucose consumption from inputs. A relationship from another strain or medium would transfer parameters across experiments and is refused by the identity rules in composition.evidence.sourcing.
suitable_paper_must_report: The host strain (E. coli 20 IBA 1 or an explicit CSH50R derivative) and the plasmid pIBAINS.
GMS medium, the glucose/proline feed strategy and the pH-stat control settings.
Either a fitted growth/uptake model with its parameters and fitting method, or the raw OD600, glucose and feed-volume series.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Register the reported relationship as a candidate finding, run the existing identity comparison against the target passages, and only then consider declaring a port. No classification is upgraded by relevance alone.
search_terms: "pH-stat" glucose feeding "Escherichia coli" specific growth rate

what_information_is_needed: A280 readings with their path length, or a concentration measurement that makes the printed dosing rules executable.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-A280-SOLUTION blocks citraconic_anhydride_volume_from_formula and trypsin_volume_from_formula. The model already refuses these equations rather than guessing the missing term.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same citraconylation and trypsinization steps.
A280 values, wavelength, path length and any dilution.
Enough detail to reproduce the reagent volume from the printed formula.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Record the measurement and re-run the two refused equations with traceable inputs, keeping the original refusal visible until the input is actually supplied.

what_information_is_needed: A documented calibration from the absorbance scale used in this process to protein mass or IU.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-AU-CALIBRATION blocks insulin_mass_from_au, stage_recovery_percent and final_activity_from_au. Without it the model can compare AU values but cannot claim a mass yield.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same insulin construct and sample matrix, or a standard that is explicitly applicable.
Path length, wavelength, extinction coefficient and standard curve.
The link between the AU measurement and the activity assay.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Store the calibration as a separate evidence record and apply it only in a labelled calculation; the replay's reported AU values remain reported, not converted.

what_information_is_needed: A biological characterisation made on the same host and construct as the target, independent of Zielinski et al. (2019).
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: The compatibility engine's identity dimensions require the same organism, strain, construct, medium and mode. No assessed candidate satisfies them, so the target's own biology remains a single-paper record.
suitable_paper_must_report: E. coli 20 IBA 1 or an explicitly identified CSH50R derivative.
The plasmid pIBAINS and its induction/expression behaviour.
GMS medium and the fed-batch operating policy, or a clear statement of which dimensions differ.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Run the existing identity comparison against the new source and record which dimensions match. Only a full match could support a compatibility reclassification; relevance alone cannot.

what_information_is_needed: An enumerated GMS recipe or a measurement of the medium's substrate concentrations in this exact process.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-CULTURE-MEDIUM blocks glucose_initial_concentration and nutrient_balance. A medium from a different E. coli process cannot be substituted without changing the experiment.
suitable_paper_must_report: The complete GMS recipe, or an explicit citation to an enumerated formulation plus the supplements used.
Glucose and proline concentrations in the batch and feed.
The strain and process context in which the recipe was used.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Attach the recipe as a source-qualified evidence record and check whether every component name and concentration has a target-context match before any balance is attempted.

what_information_is_needed: A lysis record for this process, or a measured lysis/recovery efficiency that can be attached to the operation.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-HOMOGENIZER blocks lysis_efficiency, so the model cannot connect the harvested biomass to the inclusion bodies actually released without inventing a recovery.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same strain and inclusion-body system, or a clearly stated reason the mechanical treatment transfers.
Pressure, pass count and temperature.
Measured lysis or inclusion-body recovery with its assay.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Attach the measured recovery to the lysis operation as a context-tagged value and show its effect separately from the published replay.
search_terms: "high-pressure homogenizer" "Escherichia coli" inclusion bodies pressure passes

what_information_is_needed: A primary record of when induction happened in this process, or enough time-resolved product data to identify the transition.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-INDUCTION-TIME blocks induction_time_h and post_induction_start_h. Guessing it would silently change the meaning of the growth and production phases.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same host/vector/medium and the induction trigger.
Induction time or OD600, IPTG concentration and post-induction duration.
Enough detail to tell whether induction preceded or followed the pH-stat glucose limitation.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Store the induction record with its context, re-run the existing source-discrepancy check, and keep the conflict visible rather than resolving it by assumption.

what_information_is_needed: A time-resolved renaturation data set or a printed rate law for this insulin precursor and buffer system.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-FOLDING-MODEL blocks refolding_yield_predictive and refolding_time_predictive. The model keeps the two reported yields as observations rather than inventing a function.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same precursor, redox system, pH and temperature range.
Yield and aggregate fraction over time, with replicates.
A rate law or the data needed to fit one, including the fitting method and uncertainty.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Register the kinetic model as a candidate, compare its buffer and redox conditions with the target, and keep the existing source discrepancy about the reported yields visible.
search_terms: "inclusion bodies" refolding yield time course "Escherichia coli"

what_information_is_needed: A transfer/uptake relationship measured under the target reactor's hydrodynamics, not a correlation borrowed from a different vessel.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: MP-OXYGEN-TRANSFER blocks dissolved_oxygen_profile and specific_growth_rate_mu_max. The project's existing evidence catalogue records that no candidate examined supplies a dissolved-oxygen measurement under matching conditions.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same strain, medium and fed-batch mode, or a clear statement that the correlation is geometry-specific and why it transfers.
Air flow, agitation, sparger geometry and dissolved-oxygen measurements over time.
kLa, OUR or OTR with the measurement method and uncertainty.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Record the correlation as context-tagged evidence, compare its conditions against the target passages, and expose the residual against the dissolved-oxygen target without changing the replay.

what_information_is_needed: An independent repeat of the target process, or at least replicated measurements of its key outputs.
recommendations.why_it_is_needed: The baseline is an evidence replay of one publication. Without a second batch, validation claims would rest on the same record that defines the model.
suitable_paper_must_report: The same host, construct, medium and operating policy, or an explicitly justified equivalent.
Raw time series and endpoint measurements with replicates.
The calibration and assay methods, not only the final values.
recommendations.what_scaleup_can_do: Hold the independent batch as a held-out record, compare it with the replay without changing the baseline, and report residuals with the batch variability stated.

suitable_paper_must_report: A quantity that Zielinski also declares, with compatible units.
The same organism, strain, construct, medium and process mode, or an explicit statement of which dimensions differ.
Enough component identity to map the candidate's state to Zielinski's process roles.
